invariant: USymbolStack paints a transparent inset URectangle and an outer UPath. LimitFinder measures the rectangle even though its color is none: its minimum is translated by (-1,-1), while its maximum is width-1,height-1 and remains inside the outer path. SvekResult therefore normalizes a stack cluster from minY one unit above the outer path, moves the complete solved body down by one unit, and expands the final unscaled vertical extent by one unit.
causal_divergence: Rust originally omitted the inset frontier from package_cluster_painted_min, leaving nonempty stack clusters one base unit too high and the root canvas one unit too short. Commit 743d463a fixed that path, but the independent review found the parallel empty-package path: empty_package_painted_frontier fell through to minY zero, and empty_package_frontier_minima admitted only cloud and ComponentUml1 external frontiers. A brace-bearing empty class stack therefore retained the identical one-unit drift through a distinct render role and collector filter.
